subject: Literature
subcategory: Classic Novels That Changed the World
title: Frankenstein and the Modern Self
description: A fast breakdown of Frankenstein and the Modern Self for builders.

hook.text: In 1818, a nineteen-year-old woman wrote a novel that invented science fiction and questioned what makes us human.

buildup.text: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein told of a scientist who created life and then abandoned his creation.

discovery.text: The creature was intelligent and sensitive, but the world rejected him solely for his appearance.

twist.text: Shelley published anonymously because critics refused to believe a teenage girl could write such a novel.

climax.text: Frankenstein forced readers to ask who the real monster was: the creature or its irresponsible creator.

punchline.text: A teenager asked a question science still cannot answer.

quiz.question: Why did Mary Shelley publish Frankenstein anonymously?
options: She feared the novel was too short
Critics refused to believe a teenage girl could write such a work
She wanted to surprise her family
